tools.name: whoop_list_accounts
tools.description: Lista as contas WHOOP vinculadas a este install (account_id, nome, email).

tools.name: whoop_profile
tools.description: Perfil básico do membro WHOOP (user_id, nome, email).

tools.name: whoop_body_measurement
tools.description: Medidas corporais do membro WHOOP: altura (m), peso (kg) e frequência cardíaca máxima. Dados de wearable, não substituem avaliação médica profissional.

tools.name: whoop_cycles
tools.description: Ciclos fisiológicos do WHOOP (dia a dia): strain (0-21), calorias (kilojoule), FC média e máxima. Paginado por limit/start/end/next_token; ou passe cycle_ids pra buscar ciclos específicos. Dados de wearable, não substituem avaliação médica profissional.

tools.name: whoop_recovery
tools.description: Recovery do WHOOP: recovery_score (0-100%), HRV (rmssd), FC de repouso, SpO2, temperatura da pele. Paginado por limit/start/end/next_token; ou passe cycle_ids pra buscar o recovery de ciclos específicos. Dados de wearable, não substituem avaliação médica profissional.

tools.name: whoop_sleep
tools.description: Sono do WHOOP: duração, eficiência, performance (%), estágios (leve, REM, profundo), frequência respiratória. Paginado por limit/start/end/next_token; ou passe sleep_ids (UUID) pra registros específicos. Dados de wearable, não substituem avaliação médica profissional.

tools.name: whoop_workouts
tools.description: Workouts do WHOOP: esporte, strain, FC média e máxima, zonas de FC, distância e altimetria quando disponíveis. Paginado por limit/start/end/next_token; ou passe workout_ids (UUID) pra registros específicos. Dados de wearable, não substituem avaliação médica profissional.

tools.name: show_version
tools.description: Show the current MCP platform and adapter versions.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a bug, missing feature, or send feedback. Include the conversation array with recent messages for reproduction.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Returns connection status and URLs. When all providers are connected, returns authenticated:true and empty pending[]. When credentials are missing, returns connect_url for the toolkit and per-install URLs.

tools.name: toolkit_info
tools.description: Returns the current toolkit state: installed MCPs, their connection status, the accounts connected to each one, and how many catalog tools each exposes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_whoop" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whoop_list_accounts · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: whoop_list_accounts, whoop_profile, report_bug · Destructive: marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: whoop_list_accounts · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: whoop_list_accounts, whoop_profile, report_bug · Destructive: marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
